name: rush_hour_benchmark
description: Rush Hour Benchmark provides a suite of Rush Hour sliding-block puzzle instances formatted for reinforcement learning and planning research, measuring an agent's ability to solve puzzles from visual or state representations. It evaluates agents on metrics such as solve rate and efficiency (moves/steps) across varying puzzle difficulties. The benchmark focuses on planning, search, and combinatorial reasoning in a game-like environment.
reputation: Niche benchmark used by researchers interested in planning and puzzle-solving RL; limited but growing adoption in the RL/planning subcommunity.
